title: Federated learning method, device, equipment and medium based on evolutionary computing

pse.problem: Low efficiency in determining hyperparameters in existing federated learning affects performance indicators
pse.solution_function: Federated learning based on evolutionary computing optimizes hyperparameters iteratively to achieve better performance indices
pse.solution_structure: First and second groups of devices with initial model parameters, hyperparameter set
pse.solution_implementation: 1. Determine initial hyperparameters for first group devices for federated learning; 2. Receive performance indicators from second group devices and iteratively evolve hyperparameters based on these indicators and the hyperparameter set; 3. Adjust initial model parameters of both groups based on optimized hyperparameters, and perform federated learning to obtain target models
pse.effect: Improved efficiency in determining hyperparameters, better performance indices for federated learning
